utf8-strings.randomAccess: O(1) per string; per-character access needs UTF-8 decoding

fixed-uint16.randomAccess: O(1) per symbol (offset + index); TypedArray view, no decode

short-id-escape.randomAccess: O(1) per sequence, O(length) per symbol (variable width)

varint.randomAccess: O(1) per sequence, O(length) per symbol (variable width)

choice.reason: registry ids fit uint16 (wider ids would use a versioned extension, §6.5); fixed width gives zero-decode TypedArray views and O(1) symbol access in the binary sections the runtime already uses; the variable-width encodings save raw bytes, and the measured gzip and scan figures here are what the trade-off is judged on
choice.revisit: re-measure when the registry approaches 65,535 ids or if transfer size dominates (short-id tier is prepared by the frequency-ordered ids)
